subject.title: fix(runtime): bound CLI and fixture execution

question: Must fixture deadlines cooperatively cancel and clean up provider work before this PR can merge, or is bounding only Crabline's wait time an acceptable contract?
rationale: The current approach changes runtime sequencing: Crabline can report failure and continue while a provider operation remains active, creating delivery and process-lifetime risks that tests of the returned result do not settle.

options.title: Require cancellation before merge
options.body: Add an abort-and-cleanup contract for probe and send operations and prove that timed-out work cannot complete later or retain runtime handles.

options.title: Accept return-time bounds only
options.body: Merge the race-only behavior while explicitly documenting and owning the possibility of late provider completion and retained resources.

recommendation.title: Require cancellation before merge
recommendation.body: Add an abort-and-cleanup contract for probe and send operations and prove that timed-out work cannot complete later or retain runtime handles.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the only evidence-backed organization member directly connected to the affected runtime and provider-contract changes in the available history.
